properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Central Morgan County in southeastern Ohio...

* WHEN...Until 430 AM EDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of the Muskingum River at and near
McConnelsville is expected through tonight.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 436 PM EDT, The automated gauge at McConnelsville on the
Muskingum River was hovering near 8.8 feet. The forecast calls
for a crest of 9.4 feet this evening. Due to the recent dam
replacement, the official flood stage is no longer representative
of known impacts. Flooding of areas away from the gauge can be
expected at lower stages. At a stage of 7.5 feet, sections of
Route 669 above Malta begin to flood along with low-lying areas
near the river, including recreational boat ramps. In addition,
Cottonwood Drive just below McConnelsville floods. At a stage of
9 feet, seasonal camps along the river and low sections of Route
60 just above McConnelsville flood. Additionally, homes along
Cottonwood Drive may experience flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
McConnelsville, Malta, Stockport and Eagleport.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Flooding is occurring or is imminent. It is important to know where
you are relative to streams, rivers, or creeks which can become

creeks.

800 401 9535, when you can do so safely.

afternoon. It will then fall late this afternoon. It will
rise to 10.6 feet this evening. It will then fall below flood
stage just after midnight tonight.
